content_html:
#PINK : Terrific Movie vth Terrific Performances by Tapsee & other 2 lead ladies followed by Amitabh…….in my opinion Tapsee has completely dominated Amitabh!!! How have we wasted her talent in Telugu movies limiting her to glamorus roles 😦

Story n Dialogues : It takes guts and boldness to write such an intense story with dialogues of HUGE Impact!!! take a bow to all the cast n crew…..

Music & BGM : apt & is in perfect sync with the movies intensity

Production Values : though the film doesnt have any major production values as the film is majorly shot in a Court set and a colony but need to specify their MORAL values

DONT WATCH the film if you are expecting any sort of entertainment!!!!

DONT watch the film if you take an independent working women as granted for sex!!!!

DONT WATCH the movie if you think a girl wearing modern dresses or smoking cigerrates or Booze have a QUESTIONABLE CHARACHTER!!!!

and finally…..

DONT WATCH the film if dont understand that NO means NO!!!!

coz u will surely hate the movie and talk bad which will be a disgrace to the whole teams effort…….

Finally Movie Plot, Dialogues, Music, Performances were BANG on to what they wanted to convey!!!!
